//: MA-D16 (2026-11-24) — a made app's LOCAL view, the file a desktop with no linked login hands the browser (MADE_APP_VIEW.LOCAL_FILE): `madeAppLocalViewHead(theme, policy)`, then the page's bytes, then MADE_APP_VIEW_TAIL. No response header reaches a page opened as a file, so the head carries the app's policy in a `<meta http-equiv>` before anything it governs, and the serve's referrer policy beside it. Each `views` row composes exactly `head`, and its `csp` is `madeAppServeHeaders`' own value for the same policy less `frame-ancestors`, which a meta cannot carry. Every `refused` row composes nothing. The expected strings were written by hand from the head's text, not by the code.

views.case: no host: the page reaches nothing but itself
views.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; media-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self'; worker-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'
views.head: <!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; media-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self'; worker-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'"><meta name="referrer" content="no-referrer"><style>:root{color-scheme:light}</style></head><body>
